abstract: The prognostic significance of extragonadal rather than gonadal presentation of germ-cell tumour in 51 patients presenting between 1979 and 1988 with abdominal tumours was compared with that of 51 control patients with testicular primary tumours matched for bulk fo disease, serum tumour marker concentration, age and year of treatment. Very large volume tumour was found at initial staging in 24 extra-gonadal cases (47%) and high tumour markers in 29 (57%). Actuarial survival at 2 and 5 years was 82% and 70% for cases and 78% and 63%, respectively, for controls. These outcomes were not significantly different and the relative hazard of death for cases compared with controls was 0.7 (95% confidence intervals 0.3-1.5). Thus the presentation of germ-cell tumours with a retroperitoneal mass does not itself adversely influence prognosis compared with testicular presentation with equivalent disease extent. However it is rare for extragonadal presentation to be associated with small volume disease.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜腫瘤を呈する腹部胚細胞腫瘍(性腺外発生)の予後的意義を、1979〜1988年に受診した腹部腫瘍の患者51例について、精巣原発腫瘍の対照51例と比較した。対照は腫瘍量、血清腫瘍マーカー濃度、年齢、治療年で対応させた。性腺外例の24例(47%)で初期病期分類時に非常に大きな腫瘍量が、29例(57%)で高値の腫瘍マーカーが認められた。生存率は2年・5年で、症例群82%・70%、対照群78%・63%であった。両群に有意差はなく、死亡の相対ハザードは0.7(95%信頼区間0.3〜1.5)であった。したがって、後腹膜腫瘤による性腺外発生そのものが、同等の病変の広がりを持つ精巣発生と比べて予後を悪化させることはない。ただし、性腺外発生が小病変に伴うことは稀であった。
